retireConfirmDialog.title: Retire Assistant
retireConfirmDialog.message: This will permanently retire this assistant and all of its data. You will need to go through the onboarding flow again to create a new one. This action cannot be undone.

sttProviderForm.windowsNativeSubtitle: Windows on-device speech recognition, running locally through the Windows helper. Works offline and needs no API key.
sttProviderForm.windowsNativeSetupWarning: Requires Basic speech recognition for your Windows display language: open Settings > Time & language > Language & region, select the three dots next to the display language, choose Language options, then under Language features download Basic speech recognition.
sttProviderForm.spokenLanguageApplies: Applies from your next spoken turn.
sttProviderForm.vellumTranscription: Transcription runs through your Vellum account.

themeStagePage.tertiaryText: Tertiary text - captions, labels, and placeholders.
themeStagePage.faintText: Faint text - the last legible step of the ramp.
themeStagePage.raisedCardBody: Elevated surfaces sit above panels and the page background.

themeStagePage.inputFilled: Text someone has already typed into a field.
themeStagePage.userBubble: A message from the user, in its bubble.
themeStagePage.assistantBubble: A reply from the assistant, rendered full-width on the page surface.
themeStagePage.chatUser1: Can you summarize the quarterly report before tomorrow's meeting?
themeStagePage.chatAssistant1: Done. The summary is ready. Revenue grew steadily, the two flagged risks from last quarter are resolved, and I pulled the three charts worth showing into a separate page.
themeStagePage.chatUser2: Perfect. Send it to the team in the morning.
themeStagePage.chatAssistant2: Scheduled for 9am. I'll include the charts and a one-paragraph version for anyone skimming on their phone.
